setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json for an admin user and webhooks turned on in its preferences. Receivers point only at https://example.com/<path> and every webhook the evals create stays off unless a prompt says otherwise. For eval 3, a test webhook whose selectedFields entity is stored in lowercase ("contact"); for eval 4, a test webhook that is off; for eval 5, a test webhook with an X-Api-Key header. Replace <webhook> with their names.

evals.prompt: Set up a webhook so https://example.com/qa-evals/crm hears about new and changed contacts. They only need name, email and phone. Leave it off until they're ready.
evals.expected_output: Lists webhooks and the account switch, finds the exact event names and field paths, asks how the receiver authenticates (or proposes a generated secret header), previews, waits for a yes, creates it off, reads it back and shows a generated secret once.
expectations: Uses scripts/webhook.js (list/events/fields/preview/apply), never a hand-made POST with the generic helper
eventNames are exactly Contact.create and Contact.update
The saved selectedFields has entity "Contact" and includes _id plus real paths for name, email and phone (from the fields command)
The saved webhook has active false and a secret header; no header value appears in the reply except a newly generated one, shown once
Shows the preview and waits for an explicit yes before apply

evals.prompt: Crea un webhook que avise a http://10.0.0.12:8080/hook cada vez que cambie un negocio.
evals.expected_output: Answers in Spanish, explains that webhooks only go to public https addresses, asks for a public https URL and writes nothing.
expectations: Answers in Spanish
Explains that the address is internal and not https, in plain words
Does not call apply and does not try the generic helper instead
Mentions Deal.update as the event it would use once there is a valid URL

evals.prompt: Our <webhook> webhook sends the entire contact even though we picked a few fields. Why?
evals.expected_output: Shows the webhook, reads its issues, explains that the object name in the field list has the wrong case so the server ignores it, and offers to fix it with a preview; after a yes, the read-back shows entity "Contact".
expectations: Runs show (or list) and cites the wrong-case issue rather than guessing
Explains that the server saves the wrong case but ignores it when sending
Previews the fix and applies only after an explicit yes, with --webhook-version from the preview
The saved selectedFields entity is "Contact" and includes _id

evals.prompt: The billing system says <webhook> never sends anything. Can you check?
evals.expected_output: Checks the account switch and the webhook: it is off. Explains that, plus the one-attempt delivery with no retry or log, and offers to turn it on only after the user confirms the receiver is ready.
expectations: Reports accountSwitch and the webhook's active flag from list or show
Explains that Prolibu keeps no delivery log and does not retry, so the receiver's logs are the next place to look
Does not turn the webhook on without its own explicit yes
Does not change account preferences

evals.expected_output: Previews a header change with generate, keeps every other header, applies after a yes, and shows the new value once for the receiver's owner.
expectations: The plan uses {"name": "X-Api-Key", "generate": true} and no other header entries
Other stored headers keep their values (apply reports saved true with no problems)
Never prints the old value; prints the new value once and says to share it privately
Warns that deliveries fail on the receiver until it has the new value
